overview.title: Browsing overview
overview.subtitle: See how your time on the web is spent

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Control your data and how it is recorded

range.invalid: The end date must be on or after the start date
range.label: Date range: {{range}}

error.title: Couldn't load or save data
error.connect: Can't reach the recording service. Please reload the extension.
error.save: Couldn't save records. Check your browser's storage space.
error.read: Couldn't read local records. Reload this page; if it keeps happening, reload the extension.
error.data: Saved records have an invalid format. They have been kept unchanged. Retry after restoring valid data.

empty.title: Your browsing will show up here
empty.description: After you visit a page, active time, the timeline, and site rankings appear on this page.

compare.basisAsOf: Previous period: {{range}}. Both periods are counted up to {{time}} on their last day.
compare.unavailable: Not enough recorded data to compare.

filter.emptyDescription: {{domain}} has no active time on this chart.
filter.emptyRankingDescription: {{domain}} has no records in this range.

timeline.title: Today's timeline
timeline.label_one: Today's active browsing timeline, {{count}} session; blank areas have no recorded activity.
timeline.label_other: Today's active browsing timeline, {{count}} sessions; blank areas have no recorded activity.
timeline.empty: No active browsing recorded today yet

heatmap.title: Active hours
heatmap.caption: Each cell is the average active time for that hour
heatmap.label: Active hours by weekday and hour. {{summary}}
heatmap.empty: No active browsing in this range

ranking.title: Top sites
ranking.emptyDescription: Visit a web page and it will appear here automatically.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the display language for PageTime.
language.label: Display language: {{language}}

theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Use light, dark, or follow the system. This choice stays on this device.
theme.label: Appearance: {{mode}}

recording.title: Browsing records
recording.description: Counts page visits and only tracks time on the active tab of the focused window.

audible.title: Keep counting while audio plays
audible.description: If the active tab in the focused window is playing unmuted sound, idle time still counts. Timing stops as soon as the sound stops or the tab is muted.

idle.title: Idle threshold
idle.description: How long without keyboard or mouse input before this browser counts as idle.
idle.label: Idle threshold: {{duration}}

siteMerge.title: Group subdomains
siteMerge.description: Changes how the overview and site details are grouped. Saved records keep the original hostname, and you can switch at any time.
siteMerge.label: Subdomain grouping: {{mode}}

recordMode.title: Recording scope
recordMode.description: Choose which sites are timed from now on. The blacklist and the whitelist are stored separately. Switching mode does not clear the other list, and it does not delete or hide existing records. example.com matches that host and its subdomains; mail.example.com does not match example.com.
recordMode.blacklistHint: Record every site except the ones listed below.
recordMode.whitelistHint: Record only the sites listed below.

ignored.title: Ignored sites
ignored.description: These hosts and their subdomains are not timed and visits are not counted, the same as an internal browser page. example.com also matches a.example.com; mail.example.com does not match example.com. Existing records stay in the ledger and are not hidden.
ignored.emptyDescription: Add a host to stop recording it from now on.
ignored.error: Enter a host such as example.com. The protocol, path, and port are removed. Spaces are not allowed, and a name without a dot is only accepted for localhost.
ignored.limit: You can ignore up to {{count}} hosts.

allowed.title: Allowed sites
allowed.description: Only these hosts and their subdomains are timed and counted as visits. example.com also matches a.example.com; mail.example.com does not match example.com. Existing records stay in the ledger and are not hidden.
allowed.emptyDescription: Add a host to record it from now on. Until you do, nothing is recorded.
allowed.limit: You can allow up to {{count}} hosts.
allowed.emptyWarning: No hosts are allowed, so PageTime will not record time or visits for any site. An empty list does not mean record every site. Add at least one host before anything is recorded. Existing records stay and are not hidden.
allowed.error: Enter a host such as example.com. The protocol, path, and port are removed. Spaces are not allowed, and a name without a dot is only accepted for localhost.

badge.title: Toolbar badge
badge.description: Show today's active browsing time on the toolbar icon.

export.title: Export data
export.description: Download this device's ledger as a file. JSON holds every table plus your recording state and settings. CSV has one row per day and hostname for spreadsheets.
export.note: The file is saved only on your computer. It contains hostnames and durations, never URLs or titles.

deleteDay.title: Delete one day's records
deleteDay.description: Removes one day's active time, visits, and sessions from this device. This can't be undone.
deleteDay.label: Date to delete
deleteDay.confirmDescription: This removes that day's active time, visits, and sessions from this device. It can't be undone.

clear.title: Clear all records
clear.description: Deletes the records PageTime has saved on this device. This can't be undone.

detail.title: Site details
detail.description: {{range}} · site stats and today's active sessions

allowConfirm.title: Add this site to the whitelist?
allowConfirm.description: {{domain}} and its subdomains will be timed and counted as visits from now on. Existing records are not deleted or hidden.

ignoreConfirm.title: Stop recording this site?
ignoreConfirm.description: {{domain}} and its subdomains will no longer be timed or counted as visits. Existing records are not deleted.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this site's records?
deleteConfirm.description: This removes {{domain}}'s active time, visit counts, and sessions for every date. It can't be undone. To stop recording it from now on, add it to the ignored sites list.

confirm.title: Clear all browsing records?
confirm.description: This deletes only PageTime's local data and can't be undone.
